findings.title: Grand Theft Auto VI footage leaked after hack, developer Rockstar confirms
findings.summary_md: Rockstar Games confirmed that early development footage from Grand Theft Auto VI had been stolen in a network intrusion. More than 90 videos and images appeared on GTAForums under the account teapotuberhacker, whose post claimed access through Rockstar's internal Slack feed and threatened further releases including source code.

findings.title: Lapsus$: Court finds teenagers carried out hacking spree
findings.summary_md: A court found that Arion Kurtaj was part of Lapsus$ and committed acts including the Rockstar Games hack while on bail. Jurors heard that he used an Amazon Fire Stick, hotel television, phone, keyboard and mouse after his laptop was confiscated, then posted 90 gameplay clips and a message in Rockstar's internal Slack.

findings.title: Lapsus$: GTA 6 hacker handed indefinite hospital order
findings.summary_md: Kurtaj received an indefinite hospital order after the court heard that Lapsus$ attacks cost the affected companies nearly $10 million. Rockstar alone reported $5 million in recovery costs plus thousands of staff hours, and the judge said his stated intent to return to cybercrime meant he remained a high risk.

findings.title: Lapsus$ hacker who leaked GTA VI gameplay videos convicted
findings.summary_md: The Crown Prosecution Service announced that Kurtaj pleaded guilty to hacking Rockstar Games, BT/EE, Revolut and Uber, with sentencing set for 23 November 2026. It said the Rockstar intrusion involved 90 gameplay videos and a threat to release source code, while the Uber attack caused costs above $2.8 million and the Revolut intrusion compromised thousands of customers' information.

findings.title: GTA 6 hacker pleads guilty after release from secure hospital
findings.summary_md: Kurtaj pleaded guilty at Woolwich Crown Court to the 2022 Rockstar hack and other attacks carried out with Lapsus$. The BBC reported that he used an Amazon Fire Stick, hotel television and Bluetooth peripherals after his computer was confiscated, stealing 90 clips showing nearly 60 minutes of gameplay and threatening to release source code through Rockstar's internal Slack.
